verdict.rationale: An AI-insights feature is a fair thing to ask of a password manager, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows Bitwarden generating AI insights or suggestions from vault data inside the product. Its vault health reports (reused or weak passwords) are deterministic local checks, not AI, and the official MCP server and the `bw serve` API only let external agents read the vault, which is a developer building block rather than in-product AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
